snippet.title: Skate City – Coming May 6th to Nintendo Switch, PlayStation, Xbox, Steam and The Epic Games Store
snippet.description:
Skate City is coming May 6th to Nintendo Switch, PlayStation, Xbox, Steam and The Epic Games Store!
Wishlist now on Steam and The Epic Games Store: https://www.skatecitygame.com​

Stay tuned on social media at @skatecitygame for more details.

Trailer by Alex Geerken
Music by Type.Raw
